table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description: Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
table.description: Minimum enrichment whenever the engine is out of closed loop for any reason: the mixture is at least this rich. Check it as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling when leaning the open-loop target.

table.name: Open Loop Delay Load Threshold
table.description: Load, by rpm, above which the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group takes effect after a delay; below it that group is off.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive
table.description: Extra open-loop enrichment added to Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier: full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1. Probably the classic knock-dependent extra fuel. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Knock-dependent extra enrichment for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its DAM multiplier (full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Fuel removed from the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its own DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). Leaning only works where Primary Open Loop Fueling is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive
table.description: Fuel removed from Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). It only leans the target where the TGV/AVCS group is not richer.

table.name: Low-DAM Enrichment
table.description: Extra fuel, by rpm and load, that richens the closed-loop target, the closed-loop override and the open-loop floor, scaled up as DAM falls (Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier). Probably a knock-history safety enrichment.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open)
table.description: Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs open, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed) by TGV position and scaled by Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier. Raising it adds fuel while cold. Warm-up role inferred from the coolant axis.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed)
table.description: Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs closed, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open) by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel while cold.

table.name: Fuel Factor Correction (RPM x Load)
table.description: General fuel correction by rpm and load in open and closed loop (128 = no change, each count about 0.4 %). Probably a light-load base-fuel correction.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate)
table.description: Replacement for Primary Open Loop Fueling plus its knock additive, used only when the calibration switch 'Open Loop Fueling. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate) if you enable it.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)
table.description: Replacement for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group plus its knock additive, used only with the 'Use Alternate Map' calibration switch set.

table.name: Additional Enrichment A
table.description: Extra enrichment added to the open-loop enrichment at higher coolant and lower rpm.

table.name: Additional Enrichment B
table.description: Second table of the additional enrichment, used at low coolant or high rpm.

table.name: Additional Enrichment Throttle Threshold
table.description: Throttle opening above idle, by rpm, needed to enable Additional Enrichment A/B.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Off)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and little or no EGR. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Closed, EGR Active)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs closed and EGR flowing. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Closed, EGR Off)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs closed and EGR closed or nearly closed. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Active)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and EGR flowing. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Other Modes)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs closed outside normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Normal Mode)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs closed in normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Open, Other Modes)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs open outside normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Open, Normal Mode)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs open in normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Override
table.description: Alternate closed-loop target (plus Low-DAM Enrichment) that replaces the final target under a fuel-routine condition that has not been identified.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Negative Error)

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Positive Error)

table.name: Closed Loop Learning Averaging Passes

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 2

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 4

Raw units: change it proportionally.

It is the cranking pulse whenever the engine cranks in normal combustion mode instead of the start mode: after about 10 s of continuous cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set (then scaled by Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier), or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset; it also sets a floor on fuel in normal running until it decays. table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Open)

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a repeat attempt in the special start type.
Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.description: Purge capacity by rpm and load used instead of the vacuum-based capacity when one of several unidentified fault/status flags is set.

table.name: Purge Rate (Open-Loop Enrichment)
table.description: Purge rate by load while open-loop enrichment is active.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map for pedal pressed, EGR off and TGVs open, which covers wide-open throttle and high rpm. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is off (or only a few percent) and the TGVs are closed (typically cold or light-load running). The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning, so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Open)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is active and the TGVs are open (part-throttle cruising). The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus EGR advance, knock correction advance and fine learning, so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one. One of four base maps selected by EGR and TGV state.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is active and the TGVs are closed. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning (then feedback knock correction and retards apply), so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one. One of four base maps selected by EGR and TGV state; that the switching module is EGR is inferred.

table.name: Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier
table.description: Scales Base Timing IAT Compensation by rpm and load: 0 = no intake-temperature timing correction, 1.0 = the full amount.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation Weight (TGV Open)
table.description: Percentage (by rpm and load) of Base Timing Coolant Compensation (TGV Open) actually applied. Lower values reduce the cold-engine timing correction in that area.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation Weight (TGV Closed)
table.description: Share of the TGV-closed coolant timing compensation that applies, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Timing Request Enrichment Retard
table.description: Retard ramped into the timing request while open-loop power enrichment is active, by load and rpm. The ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and request + knock advance.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (Alternate, Below 5000 RPM)
table.description: Alternate cold-engine timing correction by coolant temperature, used below 5000 rpm only when a calibration switch selects the alternate tables.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (Alternate, Above 5000 RPM)
table.description: Alternate cold-engine timing correction by coolant temperature, used above 5000 rpm only when a calibration switch selects the alternate tables.

table.name: Filtered RPM Rate Timing Term
table.description: Timing added or removed according to how fast engine speed is changing, which looks like an rpm-oscillation (surge) damper.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max A (TGV Open)
table.description: First part of the knock correction advance (timing added as DAM rises), by rpm and load, for TGVs open; blended with the TGV Closed table and scaled by KCA DAM Curve A. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, not to the Base Timing map: the ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and Primary + knock advance + fine learning, so raising it adds timing only where that sum is still below Base Timing.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max A (TGV Closed)
table.description: First part of the knock correction advance (timing added as DAM rises), by rpm and load, for TGVs closed; blended with the TGV Open table and scaled by KCA DAM Curve A. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, not to the Base Timing map: the ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and Primary + knock advance + fine learning, so raising it adds timing only where that sum is still below Base Timing.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max B (TGV Open)
table.description: Second part of the knock correction advance, by rpm and load, for TGVs open. The total available advance is Max A plus Max B; it raises the Primary Ignition side of the timing limit and can never push fired timing above the Base Timing map.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max B (TGV Closed)
table.description: Second part of the knock correction advance, by rpm and load, for TGVs closed. Like part A it raises the Primary Ignition side of the timing limit and can never push fired timing above the Base Timing map.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 1
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 2
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 3
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 4
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: FLKC Range Load Hysteresis
table.description: Load hysteresis used when switching between fine learning knock correction load ranges, to stop flicking between cells at a boundary.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 0)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing only at high pedal, blended by DAM with Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1); this table applies at DAM 0. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps. Not the knock correction advance (renamed from Knock Correction Advance DAM 0/1).

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing only at high pedal, blended by DAM with Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 0); this table applies at DAM 1. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps. Not the knock correction advance (renamed from Knock Correction Advance DAM 0/1).

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 0)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing in a high-pedal, enrichment-limited condition in one combustion mode, blended with Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 1) by DAM; this table applies at DAM 0. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 1)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing in a high-pedal, enrichment-limited condition in one combustion mode, blended with Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 0) by DAM; this table applies at DAM 1. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 0x0D)
table.description: Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 6)
table.description: Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires (variant with an extra internal condition set).

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold
table.description: By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 0)
table.description: Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 0 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 1)
table.description: Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 1 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.

For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

table.name: Wastegate Motor Feed-Forward Duty

table.name: Wastegate Motor Voltage Compensation

table.name: Intake OCV Base Duty (Cam 1, Legacy Path)

Module (read): seg 0x100000 0x104xxx-0x106xxx is the byte-based cam path; 0x10466C (intake, called at seg_0x100000.c:3516 with rpm CD54, FFF88AA4, learned bytes FFF8147A/147C/147E, feedback bytes FFF8B368, cam errors B956/B954) forms per cam: B352 = this(rpm) x 026EB0/026EC0(FFF88AA4)/128; B356 = 147A if the cam error >= cal 0x26E82 (364 = 2.0 deg), 147C if <= cal 0x26E84 (-2.0 deg), else 128; B366 = clamp(B368 + B352 + 147E + B356 - 384, 0, 250). 0x106A0C does the same for the exhaust cams (05CF08/05CF14, factors 0298F4/029904, errors B916/B914, thresholds cal 0x298C6/0x298C8) into B380. The OCV duty routines 0x15DF20 / 0x15E63C (intake cam 1 / 2) and 0x16269C / 0x162D18 (exhaust) set duty B8DE = B366[cam] x 10 (B380 for exhaust) only when cal 0x3CCC4 bit 0 is clear (read). FFF88AA4 = (FFF88AE6 >> 8 - 10) x 1.6 (0x060000 area, read); FFF88AE6 not identified. Confidence: inferred.
